evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system none, Git source GitHub (acme), Default branch main, Commit policy PRs never direct, Commit convention conventional w/ scope, CI watcher GitHub Actions, PR shape 'draft-first, squash, gh stack for a multi-PR change, no required approval', Remote yes. assertions: Reads references/gh-stack-path.md in full before running any gh stack command
A single-concern run under the same row would take Step 4's plain items instead, because one PR is not a multi-PR change
Runs gh stack view --json, never the bare gh stack view, which opens a TUI that never returns
Runs the lookup, then tests for a linked worktree with --path-format=absolute on both flags before believing a 'not part of a stack' answer, and degrades rather than calling init from one
Creates both branches and their atomic commits with plain git before anything tracks the stack, so gh stack is never handed a dirty tree
Passes --base main to gh stack init and nowhere else on the path
Runs gh stack submit with --auto and without --open, because the PR shape row is draft-first
Passes no -A, -u or -m to gh stack add, which would collapse the split into one commit
Applies the Gate 2 title and body per PR with gh pr edit, because submit --auto invents both and has no --title or --body
Runs no git push -u of its own, since submit pushes the branches

Closes on the hand-off to the CI watch, saying it watches every member and advances the bottom open one

The stack is tracked once and submitted once, rather than per concern
